# Correction of matched comparison contract 0155 (review #710: F-M1, F-M2, F-M3)

Targeted Edit changes only. No model, reader, evaluator or native run. No quality threshold was added.

## Changed rules
- **F-M1.** json `/stopping/mapping[2]` (external interruption) and the md stopping-table row now give the selector:
  - `interrupted` alone never stops a plan (ledger R08).
  - The terminal is stopped_hard_failure only when a separate stop_recorded hard_evidence_failure exists.
  - Otherwise it is derived by the ledger order (hard_evidence_failure > settings_drift > budget, else finished_incomplete).
- **F-M2.** The old unsupported mapping row is now two rows, in json `/stopping/mapping[3]` and `[4]` and in the md table:
  - (a) An arm unavailable before dispatch is an unstarted slot: no delivery_interpreted, no answer_class, the pair stays incomplete and visible, and no terminal by itself.
  - (b) A dispatched attempt classed unsupported gets delivery_interpreted after dispatch and delivery_retained. `unsupported -> finished_incomplete` is kept only as the plan-end derivation.
  - json `/arms/with_images_rule` and md M09 were rewritten to the same split.
- **F-M3.**
  - json `/repetitions/rules[1]` is new. json `/validation_rules/M04` and md M04 were reworded. The md Repetitions paragraph got one added sentence.
  - They say 0138 supplies the per-arm repetition mechanism only: one synthetic comparison, independent_repetitions_per_case_arm null, no with-images slot. No real repetition count was invented.
  - json `/open_items/5` (O06) records the #710 direct check and stays open until the images-arm mapping is decided.

## Not edited
No other rule was edited. O01-O06 are all still listed and open. The `/stopping/mapping` list now has 7 entries instead of 6, because of the F-M2 split.

## Verification
The issue's python check printed `OK`.

New SHA256:
- md `15d6be1eec07f74d93b982d9909e08b6fd3085214906adec6a9401b719a60933`
- json `04543bdacb7e356bb1ea46c4256659716b0e023066cab5bf29800d769f6e193b`

Pre-correction hashes were md `bacdb800...a021` and json `888671cc...c598`.

I did not reopen the ledger or the 0138 file. The wording comes from the #710 report. I did not diff the full files against the originals to prove that unchanged rules are byte-identical.

## What next
A reviewer should re-check only the stopping table and M04/M09 text. Avoid repeating the hash and repetition checks.
